# PanelTemplate Cytek Aurora 5L Test

Use the search box to filter the panel template. The final two columns are editable for planning; changes remain in this browser session only.

[Download the original DOCX](PanelTemplate_Cytek%20Aurora%205L%20Test.docx){.btn .btn-primary download="PanelTemplate_Cytek Aurora 5L Test.docx"}

<tr class="laser-red" data-search=" r7 783/23 apc-ef780 apc-cy7, apc-h7, apc-vio770, apc-fire 750, novafluor red 755, ghost dye red 780"><td></td><td>R7</td><td>783/23</td><td>APC-eF780</td><td>APC-Cy7, APC-H7, APC-Vio770, APC-Fire 750, NovaFluor Red 755, Ghost Dye Red 780</td><td><input aria-label="Panel 1 for R7" type="text" value="Live/Dead"></td><td><input aria-label="Panel 2 for R7" type="text" value="Live/Dead"></td></tr>
<tr class="laser-red" data-search=" r8 812/34 apc-fire 810"><td></td><td>R8</td><td>812/34</td><td>APC-Fire 810</td><td></td><td><input aria-label="Panel 1 for R8" type="text" value=""></td><td><input aria-label="Panel 2 for R8" type="text" value=""></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<button id="panel-template-clear" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" type="button">Clear editable panels</button>
</section>

<style>
.panel-template-test { margin-top: 1.25rem; }
.panel-template-search-label { display: block; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: .35rem; }
.panel-template-filter { width: min(30rem, 100%); padding: .45rem .6rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); border-radius: .3rem; color: inherit; background: var(--bs-body-bg, white); }
.panel-template-results { margin: .5rem 0; font-size: .9rem; opacity: .8; }
.panel-template-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.panel-template-table th, .panel-template-table td { padding: .4rem .5rem; vertical-align: top; }
.panel-template-table tbody tr:not(:last-child) td { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .35); }
.panel-template-table thead { color: #fff; background: #343a40; }
.panel-template-table tbody tr { color: #111; }
.panel-template-table .laser-uv { background: #ff00ff; }
.panel-template-table .laser-violet { background: #653365; color: #fff; }
.panel-template-table .laser-blue { background: #6464ff; color: #fff; }
.panel-template-table .laser-green { background: #47d459; }
.panel-template-table .laser-red { background: #ff0000; color: #fff; }
.panel-template-table input { width: 100%; min-width: 10rem; padding: .35rem .45rem; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, .35); border-radius: .25rem; color: #111; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .92); }
#panel-template-clear { margin-top: .75rem; }
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const filter = document.getElementById("panel-template-filter");
  const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll("#panel-template-table tbody tr")];
  const results = document.getElementById("panel-template-results");
  const updateRows = () => {
    const query = filter.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const visible = rows.filter(row => {
      const matches = row.dataset.search.includes(query);
      row.hidden = !matches;
      return matches;
    }).length;
    results.textContent = `${visible} of ${rows.length} detector rows shown`;
  };
  filter.addEventListener("input", updateRows);
  document.getElementById("panel-template-clear").addEventListener("click", () => {
    document.querySelectorAll("#panel-template-table tbody input").forEach(input => { input.value = ""; });
  });
  updateRows();
});
</script>
